title: Phase-1 adversarial review

currentMainReview.materialSharedChange: CMP-7 SDK/API/CLI/Indexer merged after the HZ-GCA branch base
currentMainReview.conclusion: No HZ-GCA authority contradiction found: the new Compute API prepares unsigned Wallet-authorized intents, marks projections authoritative:false, rejects secret material and requires canonical/finality reconciliation. This ordinary architecture-review step does not require ceremonial branch reconciliation; HZ-GCA-1.20/Level-3 retain their documented reconciliation duties.

reviewMethod: attack each authority boundary by substituting a lower-authority or derived source
attack privacy by attempting visibility widening and evidence disclosure
attack idempotency/replay by retrying exact and modified payloads
attack rights/consent by substituting possession, training permission, provider metadata or moderation for canonical authorization
attack economics by conflating quote/funding/earned/paid/refund states and inducing retries after ambiguous timeout
attack storage/recovery by replaying stale caches/backups/projections and hash-mismatched bytes
attack Community/Charts/Awards boundaries by converting social popularity, raw plays or votes across domains
attack Awards determinism through ballot mutation, Sybil duplication, hidden tie-breaking and retroactive policy changes
attack moderation/Arbitration through privilege escalation and ambient remedy execution
attack dependency failure/restart ordering by forcing degraded components and stale projections
review current main shared-dependency changes for contradictions with the frozen architecture
